descriptionNew: Complete the steps — your draft is saved automatically. After moderation, the listing will appear in search.
descriptionEdit: Changes are saved automatically. Changing the address, type or deal type will send an active listing back to moderation.

save.local: The draft is saved in this browser — it will be saved to the server once you fill in the type, location, area and price

type.heading: What kind of space are you listing?
type.businessTypesHint: Choose 1–5 types the space is suitable for. The type determines the required technical passport fields.
type.errorTypes: Choose at least one business type

location.heading: Where is the space located?
location.mapHint: Click on the map or drag the pin to the space's entrance.
location.errorPin: Mark the space on the map

passport.heading: Technical passport
passport.hint: Businesses search using filters: power capacity, ceiling height, extraction. * — required field for your business type.

media.heading: Photos, floor plan, video
media.hint: Real photos of the facade, entrance and interior. 5+ photos increase the number of calls.
media.uploadHint: Drop files or choose them from your computer. The first photo is the cover. Drag to change the order.
media.fewPhotos: Add {count} more photos — listings with 5+ photos get calls more often

price.heading: Price and terms
price.recommended: Price based on the district average: {price}
price.noRecommendation: Specify the location, area and price to get a recommendation
price.slotsHint: Specify the days and hours when the space is available for short-term rent.
price.slotsNeedDraft: The calendar will become available after you save the draft.
price.equipmentHint: List the equipment with prices — the buyer will see a separate total.
price.offPlanHint: For a space in an off-plan building, specify the project and completion date.
price.historyHint: Which businesses operated here before. 3+ closures within 3 years will be disclosed to the tenant in advance.

describe.heading: Title and description
describe.title: Title
describe.titleHint: e.g. “Café space with a shopfront, 64 m² — Vake”
describe.generated: Description generated — review and edit it
describe.generatedTemplate: Description generated from a template — review and edit it
describe.errorTitle: Title must be at least 5 characters
describe.aiHint: Generated from the listing facts — type, area, passport and location. Edit it afterwards.

review.heading: Review
review.moderation: After publishing, the listing goes to moderation — usually within 1 business day.

verification.heading: Owner verification
verification.hint: Upload an extract from the Public Registry — once a moderator confirms it, the listing will get the “Verified owner” badge.
verification.none: No verification request has been sent yet
verification.needsSave: Verification will become available after you save the draft.
